scope: Preparation only: mocked phase/provenance/lifecycle tests and real installed entrypoint denial. No actual stage3 encryption or accuracy claim.
actual_prerequisites_required: caller-pinned complete upstream size0 private fixture
retention: Actual attempts retain owned I/O and remaining private request pair; external key workspace is never removed. The unchanged handler retains its own internal rollback policy.
containment: Public fixture report hash/path extraction occurs before output creation; full key→model→input completion gates still precede payload/assets.
history: Earlier fake-fixture setup failure and independently reproduced cleanup-cancellation defect are preserved separately. They are not actual crypto failures.
exclusions: No secret/public key arrays, ciphertext payloads, private inputs, model tensors, model predictions or labels are archived.
